criteria.title: Derive and defend the state, ownership and ordering contract for processes, threads and lifetime ownership.
criteria.task: Build an ownership graph separating process address spaces, MAP_SHARED objects, open-file descriptions, thread stacks and join/wait records. Explain fork's private counter versus explicit shared counter and reference sequence2,3,2,1,0.
criteria.purpose: Shared physical pages after fork do not make ordinary private writes shared C objects.

criteria.purpose: A creation error does not cancel already running workers or permit freeing their arguments.
